summary: React Query Migration Batch 9 - Tested 4 migrated components. Fixed 3 bugs: SubmissionReview.js (2x fetchSubmission -> refetchSubmission), AgreementView.js (3x fetchAgreementData -> refetchAgreement), ClientOnboarding.js (added early return for missing agreementId). All 4 pages load correctly with React Query hooks.

minor.issue: Returns 404 - endpoint may not exist or not implemented

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: SubmissionReview.js - Two occurrences of 'fetchSubmission' changed to 'refetchSubmission' (lines 898, 911) - was calling undefined function
FIXED: AgreementView.js - Three occurrences of 'fetchAgreementData' changed to 'refetchAgreement' (lines 343, 414, 440) - was calling undefined function
FIXED: ClientOnboarding.js - Added early return check for missing agreementId before loading check to prevent stuck loading state when enabled: !!agreementId is false
CustomReportBuilder.js - React Query migration correct: useMutation imported but component is mostly local UI state with generateMockData
ClientOnboarding.js - React Query migration correct after fix: useQuery for agreement/payments/consultants with enabled:!!agreementId, useMutation for record payment and create kickoff

SubmissionReview.js - React Query migration correct after fix: useQuery for submission/managers with correct enabled flags, useMutation for all HR operations (save assignment, verify docs, verify bank, request revision, reject, complete)
AgreementView.js - React Query migration correct after fix: useQuery for agreement data with agreementId, useQuery for new agreement data with quotationId/pricingPlanId, useQuery for consultants
context_for_next_testing_agent: React Query migration Batch 9 complete. All 4 components tested and working after fixes. Key issues fixed: 1) SubmissionReview.js had undefined fetchSubmission calls in HRDocumentUpload callbacks, 2) AgreementView.js had undefined fetchAgreementData calls in e-signature, upload, and send handlers, 3) ClientOnboarding.js had stuck loading state when no agreementId provided. No existing agreements in database so ClientOnboarding with valid agreementId couldn't be tested. Onboarding Hub has 24 pending, 32 in progress, 7 completed submissions.

SubmissionReview.js.cause: HRDocumentUpload onUploadComplete callback called undefined function 'fetchSubmission' instead of React Query's 'refetchSubmission'

AgreementView.js.cause: Multiple handlers (handleESignature, handleUploadSignedAgreement, handleSendToClient) called undefined function 'fetchAgreementData' instead of React Query's 'refetchAgreement'
AgreementView.js.fix: Changed 'await fetchAgreementData()' to 'await refetchAgreement()' on lines 343, 414, and 440

ClientOnboarding.js.error: Stuck on loading state when no agreementId
ClientOnboarding.js.cause: useQuery with enabled: !!agreementId stays in pending state with isLoading=true when disabled
ClientOnboarding.js.fix: Added early return check for !agreementId before loading check to show proper 'Agreement Not Found' message
